display_information.name: Kudocoin
display_information.description: Give coins to the people who helped you, right where you said thanks.
display_information.long_description: Kudocoin is a playful coin for teams and friends: everyone gets a few coins a day to give to whoever helped them, with a reason, and a leaderboard closes each season with a prize. This app adds /kudos to Slack. An admin connects the workspace to their Kudocoin organization, each person links their account once, and then /kudos @person 2 reviewed my PR gives coins under the same rules as the website. The app reads no messages or channels. Open source: https://github.com/lucas-simao/kudocoin

slash_commands.description: Give coins to someone who helped you
